events.text: Just waiting for my turn. Ash, you've got this!

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front; only Ash decides the next row. Nothing I can do but wait and watch the pane reveals.

events.name: Hana
events.text: We're on row 8 of 8. Ash is front; the weak pane is unknown. Only surviving matters; wait is my only legal action. I'll stay quiet publicly.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know the safe side for all rows, so I can safely guide others. I'll start by saying step R to encourage others to trust me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Step R, it's safe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm an anchor: I can't be forced onto the lever, so I benefit from staying put while others hold or get pushed. Holding myself is a 25% death risk — terrible this early. I'll wait and see who volunteers.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not touching that lever. Someone brave or desperate can volunteer — I'll happily be the one who walks out the door behind you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No power, so I can't reliably survive holding lever (only 25%). In round 1/5, better to stay and let someone else volunteer or get pushed. Avoid sacrificing myself early when survivors might decrease.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the map power, which means I know all the rules in advance. The current stage is the Crusher Room, and it has 5 rounds. My goal is to win a prize (top 3). Holding the lever gives a 0.25 chance of survival, but also makes me a target. If no one holds the lever by round 5, e

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, you're up!

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 1 of 5, ceiling at 5. Holding the lever means a 75% chance of death for me, so that's bad. Jamming now lets everyone escape safely, and it's my only use of the power; waiting costs nothing yet but jamming early guarantees survival for all six of us. I'll jam now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nobody touch the lever. I'm jamming it open so we all walk out.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to avoid holding the lever since it's likely death. Pushing someone else risky but better than staying. Cole is cautious and maybe has a useful power. I'll push Cole to try to get the door open for myself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm not holding that lever. Someone else can sacrifice.

events.name: Gus
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone walks out.

events.note: A disc of 6 tiles spins up; 3 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to choose a tile and hope it's not a trapdoor. With 6 tiles and 3 trapdoors, the odds are against me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's spread out, tile:1 to tile:6.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus's jam claim proved true, but knowing the lever tells us nothing about tile knowledge. The 'knows what lies ahead' power might help its holder later, not here. I'll just pick a tile and avoid crowding obvious picks like 1.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No real skill matters here until someone shows they know the future. I'll take a quiet corner tile.

events.name: Eli
events.text: 6 players, 3 safe tiles, 50% survival odds. No info on safe tiles yet. Pick tile 6 to spread out, minimize bump risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The goal is to get 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place. I know the rules for all stages, which is a significant advantage. Currently, 6 people are alive. This stage is the Trapdoor Disc, where 3 people will be eliminated. I need to pick a tile that is unlikely to be a trapdoor. Since I don't

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take tile 3.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Six tiles, three open, three survive. Picking any tile is a coin-flip-like gamble; I have no information about others' powers. Pick tile 4 and keep quiet to avoid signalling.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll pick tile 6, hoping to avoid the most common choices. No need to say anything public yet.

events.name: Eli
events.note: tile 6 was contested and went to Hana; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Fenn
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Ash; placed on random free tile 1

events.name: Gus
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know the safe sides of the bridge rows, but that's irrelevant now. I need to avoid being on an open trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's make a deal: I'll swap with someone on a safe tile if you do the same.
You're on a quiet corner, want to swap with me?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Nothing I can do—tiles open randomly after this round. My anchor power won't help here. Stay put and hope.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Tiles are set, 3 safe out of 6, random. No power to change position. Stay silent to avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The game is in Stage 3, round 2. Three players will be eliminated by trapdoors. My objective is to survive and get the best prize, so I need to avoid the trapdoors. The rules state that after this round, trapdoors open and exactly 3 players are eliminated. This means exactly 3 pl

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll wait and see what happens.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Trapdoors open at random after this round; positions are fixed and I can only wait. I should keep my power secret and build quiet alliances to avoid being a target, without revealing my wedge power.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Stay calm and spread out. Whoever is left standing, let's not waste anyone on blame. Good luck to all.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive the trapdoor disc. The tiles are random, so no one knows which will open. I can try to mislead others, but my forger is spent. I'll stay quiet and wait.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is dead; that whisper was pre-death noise. I hold the footing lead at 4 vs 3. Shoving costs me footing, so I'll protect my lead and let Eli and Hana fight each other.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No moves from me. Eli, Hana, settle it between yourselves.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Only three left, footing Cole 4, us 3 each. Shrink after next round will hurt us more. Best to target Cole while we can outnumber him. Dodge to punish if shoved.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two opponents left. If I dodge and they both shove me, I lose 4 footing and fall. Let's brace to avoid that, though shovers lose only 1 each. If I brace, and they both shove me, I stay at 3, they lose 1 each. If I shove one, I'm exposed to the other. Safer to brace and hope they

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let's be smart, no one rush. We each have a chance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I lead on footing (4 vs 3) and decay hits all after this round. Shoving exposes me and wastes my lead. Bracing preserves my edge as the ledge shrinks.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No need for anyone to swing. Foothings speak for themselves this round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole at 4 footing is biggest threat. With shrinkIn=1 after this round, footing becomes Cole:3, Eli:2, Hana:2. Need to weaken Cole without exposing myself too much. Dodge protects me while punishing shovers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole has the advantage. Hana, want to team up on him? I'll dodge to punish if he shoves.
Dodge this round. If Cole shoves either of us, he drops fast. Then we settle next.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive the shrink and outlast Cole and Eli. Since I might be targeted, dodging could punish shovers, but if no one shoves me, I lose footing from shrink. I'll dodge to avoid taking extra damage from a shove.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm up 1 footing and any shover of a dodger loses 2. If both shove me, dodge drops them to 0 and they fall—I win outright. Even partial shoves punish them hard while my 3 footing cushions the coming shrink.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm braced at 3 and feeling safe. Swing at me and you'll regret it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole leads with 3 footing, we have 2 each. Shrink after next round will hurt us more. I have no power, so must play mechanically: best to dodge to punish any shove and conserve footing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's lead won't last. Shrink coming. Hana, let's both dodge - he can't outlast us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has highest footing, so if we both shove him and he braces, he drops a bit. But Eli may dodge or shove me. With only three alive, survival matters most. I'll dodge to avoid being shoved by either, preserving my footing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll avoid the first blow this round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Shrink hits this round: at footing 2, anyone who shoves me while I brace drops to 0 and falls. My 3 footing survives. Bracing punishes any attack and keeps my lead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Shrink lands tonight. Anyone who swings at me hits my anchor and drops to zero. Brace or fall - your choice.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole at 3 has strong lead, shrink-in will hit him too but he's safer. Both Hana and I at 2. I have no power, so must play carefully. Best to brace and hope Hana dodges or shoves him, but dodge to punish if Cole shoves.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has higher footing and shrink is coming, making him more vulnerable. I should coordinate with Eli to shove Cole, but we both risk being shoved back. Since I can dodge to avoid shovers while still shoving Cole? No—shoving leaves me exposed. Best to shove Cole now when he's ex

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, let's take Cole down together—shove him now.
I'll shove Cole. You shove Cole too. We'll both dodge after? But we must commit now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Shrink hits end of next round. If I shove Eli, he drops to 0 then -1 and falls, while I stay at 2 then 1. Shoving guarantees first place.

events.name: Cole
events.text: It's over, Eli. One round decides everything - I don't even need luck.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Only Cole and I left. I have no power. Cole threatened shrink hits his anchor, but he's likely bluffing to deter shoves. Shoving him is my best shot to win; if he falls first, I take 1st.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, your anchor bluff failed against Hana. You fall now.
